---
title: "About"
---


I was born in New Jersey and lived in China with my grandparents for 4 years. Afterwards I moved to a small rural town in southern Minnesota where I lived for 18 more years.

Prior to coming to Canada for the MDS program I studied Computer science and Financial Economics at my hometown College.


The reason why I decided to pursue a Masters in Data Science is because I became very interested in both machine learning and data; more so than computer science. My college didn't offer a data science program which was one of the many reasons that drove me to UBC. 


Outside of academics I mainly spend my time in the gym, eating, sleeping, and gaming. However I never say no to spontaneous plans with friends. I also enjoy watching football and finding random youtube fixations.
